# Vagrant-Kubernetes-ROS2 Deployment

> An open-source, reproducible lab that deploys ROS2 (Robot Operating System 2) Foxy Talker and Listener nodes on a multi-node Kubernetes cluster provisioned locally with Vagrant and VirtualBox. It bundles Weave Net CNI (multicast for DDS), a Prometheus/Grafana/Dashboard monitoring stack, and Jupyter-based data analysis.

Vagrant-Kubernetes-ROS2 Deployment is an infrastructure-as-code template and step-by-step guide for running containerized robotics middleware (ROS2) on Kubernetes.
It is for robotics and cloud-native engineers, students, and researchers learning ROS2, Kubernetes, and container orchestration.
It helps users stand up, from a single `vagrant up`, a three-node Kubernetes cluster (one control plane, two workers) that can run ROS2's DDS-based publish/subscribe communication, with monitoring and metrics analysis included.
Use it when you want to run and study ROS2 on Kubernetes locally, without cloud costs.
It is different from a bare kubeadm tutorial because it ships DDS-ready networking (Weave Net with multicast), a full monitoring stack, and a working ROS2 Talker/Listener example end to end.
It is not recommended for production or edge-robot deployments; it is a local development and education lab and needs a fairly powerful host (roughly 30 GB RAM and 18 vCPUs by default, adjustable).

## Stack

- Provisioning: Vagrant 2.4.1 + VirtualBox 7.0.14, Ubuntu 22.04 (ubuntu/jammy64) VMs.
- Cluster: Kubernetes v1.29.4 via kubeadm/kubelet/kubectl; one control plane (192.168.56.10) + two workers.
- Networking: Weave Net CNI v2.8.1, chosen for multicast support required by ROS2 DDS.
- Robotics: ROS2 Foxy (osrf/ros:foxy-desktop), demo_nodes_cpp Talker and Listener.
- Monitoring: Prometheus v2.51.1, Grafana v10.4.1, Kubernetes Dashboard v2.7.0, Metrics Server v0.7.1, Helm v3.14.2.
- Autoscaling/load: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA), Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA), stress-ng.
- Analysis: Python + Jupyter, prometheus-api-client, pandas, matplotlib.

## Documentation

- [Main README](https://github.com/MSKazemi/Vagrant-Kubernetes-ROS2-Deployment/blob/main/README.md): overview, prerequisites, quickstart, architecture, FAQ.
- [Kubernetes Cluster Setup](https://github.com/MSKazemi/Vagrant-Kubernetes-ROS2-Deployment/blob/main/KubernetesClusterSetup/README.md): kubeadm cluster provisioning and lifecycle commands.
- [Network Configuration](https://github.com/MSKazemi/Vagrant-Kubernetes-ROS2-Deployment/blob/main/Network/README.md): Weave Net CNI and VM networking.
- [Monitoring System](https://github.com/MSKazemi/Vagrant-Kubernetes-ROS2-Deployment/blob/main/MonitoringSystem/README.md): Prometheus, Grafana, Dashboard, Metrics Server, access URLs.
- [ROS2 Deployment](https://github.com/MSKazemi/Vagrant-Kubernetes-ROS2-Deployment/blob/main/ROS2/README.md): deploying and testing Talker/Listener nodes.
- [Data Analysis](https://github.com/MSKazemi/Vagrant-Kubernetes-ROS2-Deployment/blob/main/DataAnalysis/README.md): extracting and analyzing Prometheus metrics with Python.
